system.description: With this spell, the druid can enter one tree, teleport, and immediately step out of another tree of the same type. The trees must be large enough to enclose the druid. The range a druid can teleport varies by the type of tree, as follows. 600 yards 360 yards 240 yards 300 yards Oak Ash, Elm, Linden, Yew Evergreen trees Other trees
